name: doublebill
title: Double Bill
description: A film-review theme printed like a repertory cinema's monthly programme in one deep teal ink on primrose stock, whose archive bills every review in bold capitals beside its date, its tags billed after it behind a large + and its description set as the programme note.

tokens.--font-display: bold geometric capitals: the site title, the menu, every title and billing, dates, tags, buttons and small labels
tokens.--font-text: the transitional serif for body text, programme notes and standfirsts
tokens.--text-xs: small capital lines: the menu, dates, labels, the box office's heading, pagination, the back link
tokens.--text-s: tags in the archive, tables, the footer note, the button, the links on the not-found page
tokens.--text-l: standfirsts under a page title, quotations, the e-mail address in the mailing slip, tags on a review, the footer's title
tokens.--text-bill: a billing's title in the archive, on the home page's chosen pieces and in its box office
tokens.--text-xl: the title at the top of each page and review
tokens.--text-code: size of code relative to the text around it
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capital lines
tokens.--tracking-title: letter spacing of the big capital titles
tokens.--color-bg: the primrose programme stock: the page background, the e-mail field, and the type on the button and the skip link
tokens.--color-text: the teal ink: all text, rules, the button and the skip link
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: the page count, the empty-archive line, the e-mail field's placeholder
tokens.--color-accent: the + before each supporting tag and between chosen pieces, the current menu item's bar, quotation and list-marker rules, the button on hover
tokens.--color-tint: a light screen of the ink: the mailing-list slip, behind code
tokens.--color-rule: fine screened rules: table rows, the menu's hover bar
tokens.--color-solid: the solid the footer and the home page's box office are printed in: the ink by day, a deep teal with the house lights down
tokens.--color-on-solid: type and the + reversed out of that solid
tokens.--color-still-shadow: the ink a cover picture's shadows are printed in
tokens.--color-still-paper: the stock a cover picture's highlights are printed on
tokens.--measure: maximum width of running text and programme notes, and the width of the home page's right-hand column
tokens.--date-col: width of the date column beside each billing on wide screens
tokens.--plus-size: size of the + before each supporting tag, relative to the tag
tokens.--plus-bar: thickness of the +'s two bars, as a share of its size
tokens.--rule: thickness of hairline rules and underlines
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the heavy rules: above each page title and the programme, the masthead's double rule, the mailing slip, beside quotations and code
tokens.--space-1: hairbreadth gap: between tags, inside the menu
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between a title and its note
tokens.--space-3: page side padding, the padding of a billing
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections and beside the date column
tokens.--space-5: the large gap: between the home page's columns, above the footer
